# HTTP API reference

Routes of the records service, generated from the doc comment on each route
registration. Errors use the shape `{"error": "..."}`.

## GET /records

Lists the records that match the query filters, ordered by id.

Access: admin, editor, viewer

Query parameters:

- `status`: `active` or `archived`
- `owner`: exact owner username
- `q`: case-insensitive text that must appear in the title

Responses:

- `200`: JSON `{ "count": n, "records": [...] }`

Errors:

- `400`: unknown status value
- `401`: no signed-in user
